# edgeos_config (Data Source)

Read any EdgeOS config node by path. A missing node is not an error: `exists` is `false` and the other attributes are null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "edgeos_config" "host_name" {
  path = ["system", "host-name"]
}

# List the firewall rule sets that exist on the router.
data "edgeos_config" "rulesets" {
  path = ["firewall", "name"]
}

output "rulesets" {
  value = data.edgeos_config.rulesets.children
}

# Decode a subtree.
data "edgeos_config" "eth0" {
  path = ["interfaces", "ethernet", "eth0"]
}

output "eth0_description" {
  value = try(jsondecode(data.edgeos_config.eth0.tree).description, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (List of String) Node names from the root, such as `["system", "host-name"]`.

### Read-Only

- `children` (List of String) Sorted names of the direct children when `kind` is `tree`, handy for listing tag nodes such as firewall rule sets.
- `exists` (Boolean) Whether the node exists.
- `id` (String) The path in CLI form.
- `kind` (String) `value` (single-valued leaf), `values` (multi-valued leaf), `flag` (valueless node) or `tree` (node with children).
- `tree` (String) The subtree as JSON when `kind` is `tree`. Decode it with `jsondecode()`.
- `value` (String) The value when `kind` is `value`.
- `values` (List of String) The values when `kind` is `values`.
